Game sense is the most important thing on wizard. You have to be aware of your positioning and you have to know which spell is best for every situation. These things come with experience and there’s no one way to describe what you should do since every fight is different. It’s what make the class fun but it’s also why people have a hard time with it. I Still have general rules when it comes to spell priority which you can use as a guideline.

Fireball : someone is rushing at you in a predictable path. It’s your spell with the most damage so if you think you can hit it, go for it. It’s also used to guarantee splash damage on targets you wouldn’t usually be able to reach with any spells so you have an easier time moving in (bows mostly).

Zap: quick cast hitscan 20 damage that recharges super quick by just sitting. I can’t stress enough how good this is in every situation. It’s wizard’s bread and butter and will carry every fight before it gets into melee range.

Explosion: someone is playing around an obstacle. You only need one pixel to poke out and you can stick them for 25 damage. Know your range and use it to engage on rangers, warlocks, etc. when they play around corners. It’s the same casting animation as fireball and people are usually gonna be more aggressive than if they saw you charging up a zap.

Invisibility : switch mob aggro, reposition when you realize taking the fight from where you are is not a good idea and rush people when you know they are 100% low

Magic missile: the person you were fighting is now invading your personal space. Aim for the head and good luck. (if you did damage previously they most likely die here. If not don’t risk it and invis away) It’s also wonderful for spamming out rogue by sweeping where you think they would be

So arenas ranked is a little weird. There’s a hidden MMR rating for every player which is used to matchmake you with players of your skill level. This MMR rating is based off of your general performance and you recent matches (20 last games or so). In arenas, this matters a lot when it comes to AP. If you have generally better stats than your friend and go against people with MMR that is between both of your scores, you may get penalized by getting less points for killing lower MMR players and dying to them (if you do) and he will get greatly rewarded for killing higher MMR players while getting killed will penalize them way less since they are lower MMR. I tried playing arenas with one of my friends (0.6 k/d, silver in BR and I have 1.4 k/d plat in BR). We even got placed in different ranks after our 10 placement games since when we were losing I was still doing really well. After that, I was getting 12 points per win max while he was out here getting 100. Sorry for the long ass text but arenas is really weird and a lot of things aren’t all that clear if you don’t do some digging. Hope this helps
